description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Fire 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Magical Blink 1] and [Fire Cloak Mode] to the user

description.name: Scorch
description.text: Six single attacks (3.05 each), causes [Imperil Fire 10% (5s)]

description.name: Attach Fire 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Magical Blink 1
description.text: Evades the next non-PHY, non-NIN attack that deals magical, fractional or missing HP damage

description.name: Fire Cloak Mode
description.text: Grants [Fire Ability +30% Boost 1] after using Scorch or Fire Wielding if the user has any Magical Blink, casts Counter: Fira when any Magical Blink is removed, removed after using Counter: Fira three times, removed if the character hasn't [Synchro Mode]

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
